mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate over the next 60 trading days signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS rise, or positive when they do not rise.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2000 units in the next 20 trading days signals robust demand, driving up equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive when HOUST crosses above 2000, or positive when it does not.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the production index (INDPRO) above 100 points in the next 20 trading days reflects stronger supply-side conditions, boosting corporate earnings expectations and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive when INDPRO crosses above 100, or positive when it does not.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5% in the next 20 trading days indicates labor market strength, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE drops below 5.0, or positive when it does not.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high levels of GDP (GDPC1 above 10000) and housing starts (HOUST above 2000) signal robust demand and supply, amplifying equity market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive when both GDPC1 > 10000 and HOUST > 2000, or positive when only one or neither are above their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% predicts stronger labor market conditions, reducing risk aversion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE drops below 4.5% in late-cycle regimes, or positive when it does not.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained increases in both the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS above 3.5%) and GDP (GDPC1 above 10000) in the same month signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, boosting equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive when both FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and GDPC1 > 10000, or positive when only one or neither are above their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Federal Funds Rate over the next 5 trading days signals tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS rise, or positive when they do not rise.
